description: Get headless web analytics for one host/subdomain the app owns (e.g. a tenant's subdomain). Returns page views and unique visitors with totals; granularity='day' adds a daily series. The host MUST be a verified origin of the project, or the request is rejected (403). Use for per-tenant or per-subdomain traffic questions.

granularity.description: 'total' (default) for totals only, or 'day' for a daily series.

host.description: The host to read, e.g. 'wes.example.com'. Must be a verified origin of the selected app.

project.description: The app to read, as a project id from list_projects (e.g. 'proj_3a8f137bccdd4f'). With a workspace key (cd_wk_) this is required unless you've set a default via use_project; with a single-app key it is ignored.

name: get_host_analytics
title: Get analytics for a host
